body.statement:
Assume the declared known assignment probabilities, instrument and stratum positivity, conditional randomization, treatment, selection, and outcome consistency, no defiers, complier-conditional directional weak selection monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\).  Let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, base convergence, the centered local expansion, the local-family affine-hull condition, effective moving-offset encoding, and the effective moving-remainder condition; impose \(c_n\to0\) for the zero-offset minimax limit and allow \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\) for compact moving-offset transfer.  Form \(\mathcal F(p_0)\), compute the separate same-law coordinate endpoints, construct the completed tangent cells, and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\).  Conditional on effective compatible density, termination, and the two-sided global transfer, these constructions give one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing global sampled-data receipt.  On compact direction sets away from active faces, tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels.  The same-law joint set obeys only
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)\subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
and no rectangle equality is asserted.
body.justification: The concrete deliverable now incorporates the exact compatible-law domain and avoids evaluating endpoint labels at laws with empty maintained fibers.
body.gap: The simultaneous rule and sampled-data minimax receipt still depend on four genuinely open decision-theoretic constructions.
body.consumer: A future completed proof will provide a replayable simultaneous multiquantile assertion rule without a rectangle-equality claim.

obligation.what_is_open: Complete the sampled-data assertion deliverable by supplying quantitative compact experiment comparison and a globally honest expanding-domain primal, and discharge its inherited effective-compatible-density premise.
obligation.obstruction: The causal identification, tangent legality, semantic cover, radius certificate, and conditional CertGluePFL stopping argument close, but the proposition also consumes the unresolved incidence-density theorem and the unproved two-sided multinomial transfer.
obligation.attempted: The observed-law contrasts, exact response-type fiber, same-law endpoint witnesses, rational tangent lift, strict chamber, compact slack localization, covariance limit, and conditional primal-dual stopping recurrence were assembled.
obligation.partial_result:
The fiber equivalence, contrast calculation, and endpoint-attainment results prove
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
with separate same-law witnesses for every coordinate endpoint.  The compatible observed-law polytope, relative-interior lift, global tangent cover, and radius proof also make the zero-offset Gaussian experiment causally lawful.  The sampled-data deliverable still lacks the quantitative multinomial comparison and one globally honest expanding-domain primal; it also inherits the unresolved effective compatible-density premise.
